name: dhcp-bounded-dhcpv4-option-area-layout-and-9fc7
instr:
dhcpv4 cannot currently marshal options within a packet-size budget or legally fragment them across the main, file, and sname areas. Add bounded marshaling so overloaded packets decode to the same logical options and downstream configuration as equivalent main-area packets.

Fragment OptionGeneric, IPs, OptionCodeList, AutoConfiguration, IP, Duration, and Uint16 deterministically. Preserve semantic atoms, empty values, byte order, and repeated codes. Unsupported values or insufficient legal capacity must return a descriptive error without partial fragments, plans, packets, reports, or datagram writes.

Follow existing option order, keeping relay-agent options last before End. Account for payload, framing, overload declarations, and each area's terminator. Address and relay-agent options spanning areas must preserve atomic addresses, serialization order, and declared reconstruction order. Valid Option Overload declarations reconstruct repeated options in main, file, then sname order. Malformed overloaded streams expose no partial packet and never reach a server handler.

Every client exchange configured with `WithPacketLayout` from `github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/client4` must apply its policy to every transmitted datagram. An impossible fixed-width layout through Client.Exchange must fail before the connection records a write. A valid file-overloaded request delivered through Server.Serve must reach its handler complete. A long opaque client option under an exact budget
